name: Caught at the Window AI
tagline: Caught at the Window AI turns one photo into the caught eating meme video
description: Caught at the Window AI is a browser tool that turns one photo into an AI-generated caught-at-the-window video, the Window Peeper trend that spread on TikTok in October 2026. Upload one clear photo of yourself (or an adult who agreed) and the scene is handled for you: a camera zooms toward a lit night window, you are caught mid-snack, stare straight back and pull the curtain. No filming, no prompt writing and no app or CapCut template needed. Download a 720p vertical MP4 without a watermark for TikTok, Reels, Shorts or the group chat. Pay once with credit packs, no subscription; failed renders return credits and photos are deleted 24 hours after completion.
